description: This file defines a collection class 'FlatIndexedCollection' with methods for inserting and collecting objects based on indexed paths, along with various condition traits and classes for filtering FlatObject instances.

classes.name: FlatIndexedCollection
classes.description: A class managing a reverse index for FlatObjects keyed by tokenized paths, with methods to insert objects and collect objects matching a predicate along a specific path.

classes.name: equals
classes.description: A condition class that checks if a FlatObject equals a specified FlatObject.

classes.name: matches
classes.description: A condition class that checks if a FlatObject's string primitive matches a regex.

classes.name: TerminalCondition
classes.description: A condition that applies a predicate to a specific path within a FlatObject.

classes.name: MultipathCondition
classes.description: A condition that applies a ValueCondition across multiple paths within a FlatObject.

classes.name: veq
classes.description: An object implementing ValueCondition to check if multiple sequences of FlatObjects are equal.

classes.name: and
classes.description: A composite condition that requires all contained conditions to be true.

classes.name: or
classes.description: A composite condition that requires at least one contained condition to be true.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a FlatObject into the reverse index based on its tokenized paths.

methods.name: collect
methods.description: Collects FlatObjects from the index that match a given path and predicate.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Method in various condition classes to evaluate the condition against a FlatObject or sequence of FlatObjects.
